notes: Your first export now plays on any PC: Crisp saves H.264 by default, which every Windows player and browser plays without an extra codec. HEVC is still in the Format menu if you want smaller files. The free mark on videos is now just the web address, crispvideo.app. Licence messages now say "this PC" instead of "this Mac", and closing Crisp always ends its helper programs, even ones that were starting up.
